{"metadata":{"description":"Native DeepSeek Harness plugin: gates pwsh tool calls against PowerShell pitfalls via the official tools/pre-execute interception point, bundles the powershell-check skill","id":"gh:1334463153","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-powershell-check","slug":"chaggle/dsh-powershell-check","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","plugin","powershell","pwsh","skill"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Native DeepSeek Harness plugin: gates pwsh tool calls against PowerShell pitfalls via the official t"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ools/pre-execute interception point, bundles the powershell-check skill"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @chaggle/dsh-powershell-check"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A native DeepSeek Harness plugin that **gates every `pwsh` tool call** against the PowerShell pitfal"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ls documented in the blog post PowerShell 实战踩坑大全 (GBK console mojibake, `$var:` parsing, PS 5.1 tern"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ary, double-quoted variable expansion, JS escaping, Start-Process quoting and sandbox traps, `-Featu"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"reName` arrays, DISM verbs, `RestoreHealth` source versions, CDN downloads, `npm.cmd` suffix, `&&`/`"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"||` chains), and bundles the `powershell-check` skill."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Installable as a profile plugin: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @chaggle/dsh-powershell-check` (or"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" mount the row directly — see Install)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Automatic gate** — subscribes to the official `tools/pre-execute` interception point; every `pws"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"h` call is statically checked before execution. Blocking violations (R2–R11, R14, R20) return a `den"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"y` whose reason IS the fix guidance; advisory hits (R1, R12, R13, R15–R19, R21–R23) pass through. `w"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"arn` mode only logs.
- **Bundled skill** — exposes `powershell-check` through `ctx.skills.registerPr"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ovider` (the `dsh-skill-badge` pattern), visible and loadable in every session catalog.
- **Bilingua"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"l** — rule text, CLI output (`--lang en|zh`), deny reasons, and docs ship in English and Simplified "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"Chinese.
- **Single rule source** — the rules engine (`src/checker.ts`) is shared by the gate and th"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"e CLI; update once, both follow.
- **Self-test** — `--selftest` runs a 77-case positive/negative bat"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"tery (R1–R23, AI-generated-script focused, including the false-positive regressions for R10).

The manifest declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3."},{"id":"p8s2","text":"0"` and pins the DSH packages the plugin imports (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-shell`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`"},{"id":"p8s3","text":", `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, all `^0.2.1-rc.3`; `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `^4.0.5`). Both stay inside their current major version and apply o"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"nly to this repository's typecheck and test tree; the published package's runtime dependencies remai"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"n the host-provided peers."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### As a profile plugin (recommended)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The package declares `dsh.bundle` (patch: `./cordis.patch.yml`), so it is installable per profile:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"or add the row to your profile layer `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"If the harness was launched from a checkout, either publish the package or point the row at a local "},{"id":"p17s2","text":" harness was launched from a checkout, either publish the package or point the row at a local clone:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"User patch layers are watched: the change hot-applies to a running `dsh web` instance (transactional"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" HMR) without a restart."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Skill only (no gate)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The repository root is a skill bundle (`SKILL.md` + `scripts/`); clone it into any skill root:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `mode` | `deny` | `deny` blocks pwsh calls with blocking violations; `warn` logs and allows |

| `analyzer` | `builtin` | `bui"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ltin`: bundled R1–R23 rules only. `psscriptanalyzer`: additionally deep-checks every pwsh command wi"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"th the official PSScriptAnalyzer (install the module on the host; degrades to builtin when missing)."},{"id":"p25s5","text":" Error/ParseError findings deny, warnings are logged |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## CLI"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Exit codes: 0 = PASS, 1 = FAIL (violations listed with fixes), 2 = usage error."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Rules"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Rule | Level | Detects | Blog section |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| R1 | advisory | wsl/Windows feature queries without `chcp 65001` | §1-1-3 |

This plugin uses two entries:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"1. `ctx.on(`tools/pre-execute`, (exec, next) => PreToolDecision)` — the pre-execution waterfall gate"},{"id":"p34s2","text":";
2. `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)` — contributes the bundled skill to the registry."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Nothing is injected into prompts by this plugin. The skill is exposed through the standard session s"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"kill catalog (`powershell-check`, description above) and can be loaded with the `skill` tool. When t"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"he gate denies a pwsh call, the model sees the deny reason in the tool error result — that reason is"},{"id":"p36s4","text":" the fix guidance generated by `formatHits`."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- **Static heuristics** — rules are pattern-based; R1 is advisory by design and R4 may flag intended"},{"id":"p38s2","text":" variable expansion (the fix text says when to ignore).
- **Live reload** — code changes require the"},{"id":"p38s3","text":" running harness to re-import the plugin (user-patch rows hot-reload; the module cache reloads on ro"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"w replacement).
- **Rule count** — R10/R11 cover the ExecutionPolicy and `&&`/`||` traps; new pitfal"},{"id":"p38s5","text":"ls should be added to `src/checker.ts` with selftest cases, then mirrored in the blog post."}],"truncated":true}
